subject: PO fields, weekly invoice run, and net terms for BrightBridge engagement
messages:
From: Sasha Newman <sasha.newman@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement_team@brightbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO fields + invoice run frequency for Redwood engagement

Hi Kimberly,

We're getting close to completing our internal PO for the Redwood engagement. Before I route it through our AP system I need to confirm a few procurement technicals so we don't get rejected by our ERP matcher:

- Required PO fields: we need to know exactly which custom fields Redwood needs to qualify for the negotiated discount (cost_center, contract_reference, billing_entity, any master agreement id). Can you provide the exact field names and an example?
- Invoice cadence: our AP team prefers a weekly invoice run for usage-based services. Is Redwood able to provide weekly invoices (PDF + line-level usage) mapped to a single PO across the week?
- Net terms: are you able to accept Net30? We can consider Net14 in exchange for a 1.5% early-pay discount, but our Treasury prefers Net30 for vendor cashflow.
- PO format: attaching a draft of the PO our legal team created for the program (BBH_Draft_PO.xlsx). Can you confirm whether you need changes to the header or additional fields for discount eligibility?

We'd like to avoid a manual workaround if our AP matcher rejects the PO. Please loop in procurement/ops on your side if helpful.

Thanks,
Sasha Newman
Senior Procurement Manager
BrightBridge Health
attachments: BBH_Draft_PO.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Newman <sasha.newman@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice run frequency for Redwood engagement

Hi Sasha — thanks for the draft and for flagging the matcher risk. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Canonical PO fields for our ERP matcher (please include these exact keys in your PO):
   - vendor_legal_name (string) => "Redwood Inference, Inc."
   - billing_entity (string) => use the invoice entity listed on our SOW (we'll confirm below)
   - contract_reference (string) => your internal contract id / MA number
   - cost_center (string) => required for internal chargebacks and to claim discounts
   - po_issue_date (date) and po_total (decimal)

   Note: discount eligibility is conditional on the presence of both billing_entity and contract_reference fields. Without both present our finance system will treat the PO as 'unverified' and discounts cannot be applied automatically.

2) Weekly invoices: yes — we can generate a consolidated weekly PDF that contains line-level usage and token/day breakdown. We'll map all weekly charges to a single PO if you provide the PO number that covers the entire week. One implementation note: for weekly runs we require a stable PO number per billing week so our ingestion pipeline can reconcile automatically.

3) Net terms: we can accept Net30 as standard. We can make an early-pay discount (1.25%) for Net14 in special cases, but to honor the expanded volume discount you requested in the SOW we need the PO to include the contract_reference and billing_entity fields as listed above.

4) Attachments: I'm attaching our Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx and a short Discount_Terms_Summary.pdf that outlines the rule set we apply when evaluating PO fields and applying negotiated rates. Please review and let me know if your procurement team needs different field names or if we should accept any aliases.

I'll hold on the billing entity exact text until our finance team confirms; tagging Ben (pricing) and Vivek (legal/finance) to approve the final billing entity and discount carveouts.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx, Discount_Terms_Summary.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice run frequency for Redwood engagement

Kim / Vivek — quick internal note on the discount angle before we confirm to BBH:

- The negotiated volume discount (5% tier at $120k MRR equivalent) must be tied to a verifiable contract_reference in the PO. If the PO arrives without that key we can still honor a retroactive credit but only after manual verification (that creates a 2-3 week reconciliation backlog for finance). That is acceptable for onboarding but not ideal for BBH's month-one cash forecasting.
- Weekly invoicing is fine operationally; however if BBH splits POs across cost centers (multiple POs in a week) we need a mapping sheet up front so our ingestion can stitch them to one consolidated customer account for discount evaluation.
- Recommendation: accept Net30, require the three canonical fields (vendor_legal_name, billing_entity, contract_reference) and request BBH to include an additional 'po_group_id' if they will send multiple POs per week. If they cannot create po_group_id, offer a simple template where they can put a repeating header value we can use as the stitch key.

If legal signs off on the billing_entity string we can send final PO template to Sasha today.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Sasha Newman <sasha.newman@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement_team@brightbridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice run frequency for Redwood engagement

Kim — thanks for the clarity and the templates. We reviewed internally and are good with the approach. Confirming:

- BrightBridge will issue a weekly PO aggregation linked to a single contract_reference and billing_entity. We'll include the exact field names you specified.
- We'll add an internal po_group_id column (same value for all POs in a week) so your ingestion can stitch multiple POs when needed.
- Net30 is acceptable. Triage: we'll try Net14 for month one if finance can process the early-pay discount, but default will be Net30.

I've attached the final PO file with the requested header fields populated (BBH_Final_PO_with_fields.xlsx) and I'll circulate the DocuSign for the SOW after legal greenlights the billing_entity string.

Could you send the final invoice header format (CSV column names + example PDF) so our AP team can pre-map their matcher? That would avoid delays.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sasha
Sasha Newman
Senior Procurement Manager, BrightBridge Health
attachments: BBH_Final_PO_with_fields.xlsx
